description: Input contract of K-LCR, version 1: three CSV files describe one run. DATA_CONTRACT.md explains it; tools/check_contract.py is its reference validator.

format.encoding: UTF-8, with or without a byte-order mark
format.blank: an empty field is missing, never zero

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: Identifier of the run, chosen by the provider.

columns.name: profile
columns.description: Regulatory profile (D002). There is no default.

columns.name: parameter_set
columns.description: Parameter set of the profile, named after its source edition (APPLICABILITY.md).

columns.name: source_register_version
columns.description: Version of the source register the run cites.

columns.name: reporting_date
columns.description: Date at which the LCR is measured; the 30-day horizon starts after it.

columns.name: reporting_currency
columns.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of every amount (A02).

columns.name: perimeter_type
columns.description: Level of application of the perimeter, declared by the provider; K-LCR does not consolidate (A01).

columns.name: perimeter_id
columns.description: Identifier of the institution or group the data describe.

columns.name: synthetic
columns.description: Y: the repository holds synthetic data only.

columns.name: asset_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the holding, compared case-insensitively.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Liquid-asset category of the run's profile (categories.json).

columns.name: market_value
columns.description: Market value before haircuts, in the reporting currency.

columns.name: original_currency
columns.description: Currency in which the asset is denominated (A02).

columns.name: requirements_met
columns.description: Y when the holding meets the general and operational requirements of its profile (Art. 7 and 8; LCR30.13 to LCR30.28), as asserted by the provider.

columns.name: flow_id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the outflow or inflow item, compared case-insensitively.

columns.name: direction
columns.description: Whether the item is an outflow or an inflow.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Outflow or inflow category of the run's profile, matching the direction (categories.json).

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Outstanding balance, committed amount or contractual amount, in the reporting currency; the direction gives the sign.

columns.name: original_currency
columns.description: Currency in which the item is denominated (A02).

columns.name: maturity_date
columns.description: Contractual maturity or next payment date; required for inflows. Blank for an outflow without a contractual maturity.

columns.name: collateral_category
columns.description: Liquid-asset category of the collateral of a secured transaction or collateral swap; blank otherwise.

columns.name: netting_set_id
columns.description: Netting set of a derivative item; blank otherwise.

findings.LCR-ENCODING: The file is not valid UTF-8 or contains a NUL character.
findings.LCR-SYNTAX: The record is not valid CSV: a quote inside an unquoted field, text after a closing quote, or a quoted field left open.
findings.LCR-EMPTY: The file has no header record.
findings.LCR-DELIMITER: The header is a single field containing a comma or a tab: the file uses another delimiter than ';'.
findings.LCR-HEADER-DUPLICATE: A column name appears more than once in the header.
findings.LCR-HEADER-MISSING: A column of the contract is missing from the header.
findings.LCR-HEADER-UNKNOWN: The header names a column that is not in the contract.
findings.LCR-FIELD-COUNT: The record has a different number of fields from the header.
findings.LCR-BLANK-RECORD: Every field of the record is blank.
findings.LCR-TOO-LARGE: The file has more bytes or records than the contract allows.
findings.LCR-RECORD-COUNT: run.csv does not have exactly one record.
findings.LCR-TYPE: The field does not have the form its type requires.
findings.LCR-NON-FINITE: A number is written as NaN or an infinity.
findings.LCR-FILE-MISSING: A file of the run is missing from its folder.
findings.LCR-PRECISION: A number has more significant digits than the contract allows.
findings.LCR-RANGE: The value is outside the range the contract allows, such as a negative amount.
findings.LCR-ALLOWED: The value is not one of the allowed values.
findings.LCR-LENGTH: The text is longer than its type allows.
findings.LCR-FORMULA: A text field starts with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return.
findings.LCR-DUPLICATE-KEY: The key repeats an earlier record of the file, compared case-insensitively.
findings.LCR-PARAMETER-SET: The parameter set is not the one of the run's profile.
findings.LCR-REGISTER-VERSION: The run cites another source register version than the contract.
findings.LCR-CATEGORY-UNKNOWN: The category is not a category of the run's profile for this file and direction.
findings.LCR-OUT-OF-SCOPE: The category is one the v0.1 decisions exclude (A03 to A06): it is rejected, never ignored.
findings.LCR-COLLATERAL: A secured category has no collateral category, a category that is not secured has one, or the collateral category is not a liquid-asset category of the profile.
findings.LCR-MATURITY: An inflow has no maturity date, or a maturity date is before the reporting date.
findings.LCR-NETTING-SET: A netting set is given for a category that is not a derivative category.

policy.any_finding: The run is rejected as a whole; no figure is calculated and no earlier result is shown as current.
policy.correction: Invalid input is reported, never corrected, rounded or given a default.
policy.inputs: Input files are never modified; the report records the SHA-256 of each file as read.
